About the Colony

Defence Garden
Phase 2

The newest Defence Garden phase in Shamli (2022) with commercial frontage on the main road and a live booking map. Defence Garden Phase 2 is a premium residential plotted development located in Shamli, UP. Designed with modern infrastructure and thoughtful planning, it offers a perfect blend of urban convenience and natural serenity.

Every aspect of the colony is crafted to ensure a premium lifestyle — from wide, well-laid roads to beautiful green landscapes. With 24/7 security, underground electricity, and dedicated water supply, this is where your dream home begins.
